lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The moon hangs low over the Delaware River, a sickly yellow coin in a sky choked with industrial haze.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The warehouse squats like a gutted beast. A dump truck backs into frame. Engine cuts. Silence slams down.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Jackie pulls back the plastic. Sal 'The Rat' Marino. Single clean bullet hole in the forehead.

lines.speaker: JACKIE
lines.text: You talked too much, Sal. Too damn much.

lines.speaker: VITO
lines.text: He gave up the docks. The union books. Everything.

lines.speaker: JACKIE
lines.text: You ever think... maybe we're the rats?

choices.text: No. We do what we have to.
(Say nothing. Just stare at the body.)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Crack. A gunshot splits the night. Vito's chest explodes in red. He drops like a felled oak.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Three masked men. Jackie returns fire. Two drop. The one with the red bandana flees.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: On the dead man's neck: a tattoo. Rizzo Crew.

lines.speaker: JACKIE
lines.text: You came to my house. My family.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN
lines.text: You killed the wrong man, Jackie. Vito was just the beginning. We take everything.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In Philly, family isn't blood. It's survival.
